title: ScriptVersions
description: script_versions.json, written into a run folder by Script-Engine-Controller before the engine starts (recordRunStart in src/vcs/hostVcs.mjs; VERSIONING.md §8.2, "Run provenance"): the commit of every script the run could load, and the device it ran on.

workspace.description: The folder the run's scripts were read from: a workspace, or a branch's folder .{workspace}.{branch}.

branch.description: For a run in a branch's folder: the branch.

branchOf.description: For a run in a branch's folder: the workspace it branches.

commit.description: The commit in the workspace's .vcs store. Null for an untracked script: it ran from the folder on disk.

version.description: From V2: the published version number, or {base}+{sha} for a drift commit.

drift.description: Scripts whose commit is a drift commit: an edit made on disk, not a deploy.

dynamic.description: The run has a dynamic reference, so versions lists every tracked script of the workspace.

device.description: The device the run was given (UI_MAPPER.md §8, C1). Null when it ran with none. Absent in runs from before 2026-11.

id.description: The device id the run was started with: a key of host_devices_config.json (avd:..., adb:..., pikvm:..., ios:..., sim:...) or file:{path}.

type.description: The device record's type (avd, bluestacks, adb, pikvm, ios, sim), else the id's prefix; file for a file device.

sim.description: A simulated device (UI_MAPPER.md §4). The UI mapper never learns from these runs.
